state: Rejected/superseded user design direction; not adopted or approved. Both generation calls produced images.
sharedSpecification:
Exactly16 full-body figures on a4x4 board. ROWS C/B/A/S top to bottom, COLUMNS MOBILITY/BALANCED/HEAVY/MAINTENANCE left to right; exact codes C1 C2 C3 C4 / B1 B2 B3 B4 / A1 A2 A3 A4 / S1 S2 S3 S4. Neutral relaxed standing at consistent scale, full hair/feet inside each cell, no guns/helmets. Same original SD heroine body proportions in every tier.

Redesign ALL equipment in a grounded contemporary TACTICAL EXTRACTION GAME direction. Replace the reference's shiny white sci-fi shells and curved hip fins with sewn ballistic nylon, matte ripstop, fabric-covered plate pockets, webbing, real side-release/quick-release buckles, stitching, reinforced seams, magazine/radio pouches, small utility/tool bags, practical gloves and compact combat boots. This is an outfit construction redesign, not a camouflage/color filter. No fantasy armor, knight pauldrons, metal corsets, white ceramic body shells, huge hip wings, coat tails, glowing cyan circles, exposed exoskeleton or ornate decoration.

Preserve subculture costume direction in a neutral professional presentation: opaque fitted cropped tactical torso layers and opaque utility shorts covering torso/seat, modest waist joint gap, open upper arms/elbows and portions of upper thighs. Keep compact SD torso and full natural hair; avoid covering everything in a generic male combat uniform. No body emphasis or exaggerated anatomy. Do not reshape the heroine to fit armor. All pouches must attach visibly to a belt or carrier rather than floating.

CRITICAL tier differences within EACH role must be readable by actual construction, not only color:
C = WORN SURPLUS WEB RIG: crossed broad canvas load straps, soft frayed canvas torso panels, coarse webbing/strap knots, externally strapped small flat reclaimed armor insert. Uneven soft utility belt and floppy canvas bags, mismatched simple flat knee guards. Faded brown/khaki/olive with restrained rusty hardware; grounded salvage, not medieval ragged dress.
B = CIVILIAN PATROL SOFT VEST: broad rounded continuous fabric-covered ballistic torso vest, clear zipper/sewn panel lines, two large lateral buckle straps, modest rounded attached soft utility pouches; padded round knee pads and simple short boots. Matte charcoal/navy-gray with muted khaki tabs. No military MOLLE grid and no outer molded white shells.
A = STANDARD MILITARY MODULAR PLATE CARRIER: obvious squared rectangular fabric plate pocket, wide cummerbund, vertical shoulder webbing and quick-release tab, external horizontal MOLLE rows, separate BOX magazine/radio pouches on chest/belt, squared strapped side plate pouches, trapezoid knee/shin guards. Ranger olive/coyote with dark hardware. Angular modular construction contrasts B's smooth rounded soft vest.
S = PREMIUM SLICK TACTICAL CARRIER: refined low-profile fabric-covered plate pocket with clipped upper corners and a subtle tapered lower edge, clean central surface, slim integrated shoulder yoke, clearly open LASER-CUT SKELETAL cummerbund sides, flush protected buckles, tidily routed radio cable, two small low-profile staggered pouches and discreet black composite edging only. Sage/stone-gray technical fabric, charcoal stretch panels and muted olive accents. NO white hard suit or neon trim. It must read as premium purpose-built real tactical kit, with less clutter and more precise fit than A; not A with a repaint.

ROLES in every row:
1 MOBILITY: small torso kit, minimal compact pouches, unobstructed arm/hip joints, small knee pads; tier's construction still visible.
2 BALANCED: standard carrier/vest, two to three magazine/utility pouches and one moderate belt pouch, normal knee pads.
3 HEAVY: broader continuous torso protection and fabric side plate pockets, compact sloping shoulder protection close to the shoulder, stronger knee/shin protection. Smooth coherent silhouette with few layers; no huge pauldron stack or multi-tier skirt. C3 strapped broad salvaged flat plate; B3 wider rounded fabric vest with padded side coverage; A3 broad rectangular modular plate carrier; S3 sleek broad plate pocket plus clean skeletal-side system and thin side plates. Beautiful compact heavy kit, not piled armor.
4 MAINTENANCE: accessible compact roll of tools, spare armor-panel sleeve at one hip, reinforced utility belt, repair service pouch, tier-appropriate buckles/straps. No medical cross, no magical auto repair. Do not confuse it with heavy: more utility storage, less broad armor coverage.

Use matte realistic textile/material cues adapted to simplified stylized3D anime game characters. Crisp silhouettes readable at small scale; soft neutral studio lighting and pale gray background. No emblems, brands, flags or extra characters. Accurate row/column labels. Footer "16 PRODUCT CONCEPTS / TACTICAL REVISION / NOT 3D FITTED".
